title: Deleting a category is sent to AccountingHub as category changes are
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use staging if AccountingHub is connected there; otherwise use the production test account after the release (a look-only check in AccountingHub).
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, with no parts.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A.
  3. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  4. Click Delete.
  5. Click Delete in the question.
  6. Open AccountingHub's category list for this client.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories page lists category A.

Step 2:

  • Category A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The menu shows Audit Log and Delete.

Step 4:

  • The Delete question opens.

Step 5:

  • Category A is deleted.

Step 6:

  • AccountingHub shows category A as removed (deactivated), the way it shows a category change today.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - runs where AccountingHub is connected: staging if it is, otherwise the production test account after the release
